hooks.name: Ship code guard — full pre-commit checks
hooks.description: Before any git commit or push, automatically run: terraform fmt, actionlint, gitleaks secret scan, conventional commit message check. Blocks on failure (exit 2).

action.command:
CMD=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null)

# Only fire on git commit or git push
if ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git (commit|push)'; then exit 0; fi

echo "🔍 Ship code guard — running pre-commit checks..."
FAILED=0
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)

# 1. terraform fmt
if command -v terraform &>/dev/null; then
  TF_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '\.(tf|tfvars)$' || true)
  if [ -n "$TF_FILES" ]; then
    echo "\n[1/4] terraform fmt"
    for f in $TF_FILES; do
      terraform fmt -check "$ROOT/$f" 2>/dev/null || { echo "  ❌ fmt needed: $f — run: terraform fmt $ROOT/$f"; FAILED=1; }
    done
    [ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ] && echo "  ✓ terraform fmt OK"
  else
    echo "[1/4] terraform fmt — no .tf files staged, skip"
  fi
else
  echo "[1/4] terraform fmt — terraform not installed, skip"
fi

# 2. actionlint
if command -v actionlint &>/dev/null; then
  WF_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '\.github/workflows/.*\.ya?ml$' || true)
  if [ -n "$WF_FILES" ]; then
    echo "\n[2/4] actionlint"
    for f in $WF_FILES; do
      actionlint "$ROOT/$f" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/actionlint-out.txt
      grep -q '.' /tmp/actionlint-out.txt && FAILED=1 || echo "  ✓ $f OK"
    done
  else
    echo "[2/4] actionlint — no workflow files staged, skip"
  fi
else
  echo "[2/4] actionlint — not installed (brew install actionlint), skip"
fi

# 3. gitleaks — scan staged content
if command -v gitleaks &>/dev/null; then
  echo "\n[3/4] gitleaks (staged files)"
  gitleaks protect --staged --config="$ROOT/.gitleaks.toml" --exit-code=1 --redact --no-banner 2>/dev/null \
    && echo "  ✓ no secrets" \
    || { echo "  ❌ secrets detected in staged files"; FAILED=1; }
else
  echo "[3/4] gitleaks — not installed (brew install gitleaks), skip"
fi

# 4. Conventional commit message
if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git commit'; then
  MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oE '\-m ["'\''\`]([^"'\''\`]+)' | sed 's/-m ["'\''\`]//' | head -1)
  if [ -z "$MSG" ]; then
    MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | grep -oP '(?<=-m )"[^"]+"' | tr -d '"' | head -1)
  fi
  echo "\n[4/4] Conventional Commits: \"$MSG\""
  PATTERN='^(feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|perf|test|ci|build|revert)(\([a-z0-9._/-]+\))?(!)?: .{1,100}$'
  if echo "$MSG" | grep -qE "$PATTERN"; then
    echo "  ✓ commit message OK"
  else
    echo "  ❌ commit message must be: <type>(<scope>): <description>"
    echo "     Types: feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|perf|test|ci|build|revert"
    FAILED=1
  fi
else
  echo "[4/4] commit message — push command, skip"
fi

echo ""
if [ "$FAILED" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "❌ Ship code guard FAILED — fix issues above before committing."
  exit 2
else
  echo "✅ All checks passed — proceeding."
  exit 0
fi
